_description: Claude (.claude) capability -> single Cursor owner map, mirroring the Codex bundle's capability-coverage.json shape. Skeleton only: `concerns` populates as each capability's native Cursor owner (AGENTS.md, skill, agent, hook, rules, config, .meowkit, cli, or an explicit omission reason) is authored. native-surface-matrix, minimum-version-matrix, and runtime-environment-matrix are intentionally NOT created here — each lands alongside the content it describes.

adviceSupervision._description: Per-surface support state for the two --advice capabilities on this plane. Structural presence is NEVER a support claim: a state leaves `unverified` only from a recorded live smoke run. Direct consult and embedded supervision are separate capabilities and neither may be reported through the other's state.

capabilities.detail: The adapter, the contract rule, and all six wrappers (brainstorming, plan-creator, cook, fix, autobuild, ship) are authored and declare their checkpoints. No live session has exercised delegation from a wrapper on this plane, so the wiring is unverified rather than supported; a runtime that cannot reach the agent prints the documented fallback line and continues unsupervised.

The adapter declares the stateless strategy-brief contract and the runtime documents delegating to a named agent, but no live session has exercised it. Unverified is not degraded: nothing here is known to work partially.

mutationBan.detail: readonly: true in the agent frontmatter is the structural half of the no-mutation rule, and the adapter carries the behavioral half. The flag's runtime effect has not been live-verified for this agent, so the enforcement is declared structural while its state stays unverified.
